test_title: PYST 44: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 23 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: YAGK is related to RTZD in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, WYEI is related to PRXB. To which of the following options is BDJN related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

 The pattern can be summarized as **(-5, -5, -5, -5)**

**For: YAGK : RTZD**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eddac4be30ee9b9e8fd2d23295759583543f0efac525c12e7779dcd75731cd89.png] 

For**: WYEI : PRXB**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a625cc7761a4a0613475978e87c38e9f9defbc9c5f1a02b1e6cfe0d92527408.png] 

**Applying the same logic to BDJN:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9afb8de3d1fa63c77bc51cfb4b74e337f560fa9555e8dbb1723e73d4255ed8f5.png] 

Thus, BDJN is related to UWCG.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
